tools.name: run
tools.description: Run the build and tests (Maven `test` or Gradle `test` through the wrapper), wait for it, and return the results markdown it wrote. Call after every edit.

tools.name: results
tools.description: High-level markdown for the last Maven or Gradle run (same shape as jk's target/jk-results.md): outcome, why it failed, tests, compiler errors with file:line:col, failed steps. Start here.

tools.name: diagnostics
tools.description: Structured compiler and test failures from the last run: each diagnostic with task, module, file, line, col and message; each failing test with class, name, message and stack; the failed steps.

severity.description: Which diagnostics to include; default error.
